rows.quote: The dataset used in this study, designated as finngen_R10_C3_PANCREAS_ADENO_DUCTAL_EXALLC.gz, includes 731 pancreatic cancer patients and 314,193 healthy controls (n = 731 cases; n = 314,193 controls).
rows.coder_note: The dataset file is named finngen_R10_C3_PANCREAS_ADENO_DUCTAL_EXALLC.gz, the R10 release identifier, repeated in the finngen-public-data-r10 download address; the case and control counts are endpoint-specific and no conflict (rule H).

The pQTL data are the UKB-PPP cohort with reference 20 (Sun 2023, DOI verified), a source with several dictionary rows; the passages give no subcohort, ancestry, sample size or panel that matches exactly one of them (rule E not met).
